review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked its definitions against Mathlib and the supplied Tau Ceti sources. The definitions are evenDecompositionEquiv, typeDBasis and typeDQuadraticEquiv. evenDecompositionEquiv is a thin composition of LinearEquiv.prodUnique with the polarization's decompositionEquiv. typeDBasis is built with Module.Basis.prod and Module.Basis.map. typeDQuadraticEquiv delegates to the existing skewAdjointMatricesEquivQuadratic and uses Mathlib's LieAlgebra.Orthogonal.typeD and JD. I found no independent competing version of a Mathlib concept. The file reuses existing Mathlib and project notions and adds only specific bridging definitions and lemmas. My search was targeted, not exhaustive, so some uncertainty remains about the project-internal helper definitions I did not read in full.
